headline: y30: w=0.7; hybrid PR-AUC 0.226 vs cascade 0.232 vs first-gen-ETAS 0.223; IG(hybrid vs cascade)=+0.249, IG(hybrid vs first-gen-ETAS)=-0.142, IG vs smoothed +0.515 | y35: w=0.6; hybrid PR-AUC 0.128 vs cascade 0.129 vs first-gen-ETAS 0.126; IG(hybrid vs cascade)=+0.262, IG(hybrid vs first-gen-ETAS)=-0.374, IG vs smoothed +0.514 | y45: w=0.2; hybrid PR-AUC 0.074 vs cascade 0.068 vs first-gen-ETAS 0.067; IG(hybrid vs cascade)=+1.119, IG(hybrid vs first-gen-ETAS)=-3.305, IG vs smoothed -4.202
verdict: PRIMARY = y30 (M>=3.0, 592 test positives, ~3x y35): the powered comparison where ML-vs-ETAS separation is statistically resolvable at all; read the ranking off claims.json (block-bootstrap verdicts). y35 (M>=3.5, 167 positives): cascade PR-AUC 0.129 vs first-gen 0.126. The difference is WITHIN the bootstrap CI (inseparable; see claims.json); the old 'cascade ranks best' headline is not supported. y45 (M>=4.5, only 22 test positives): UNPOWERED: bootstrap CIs are enormous and essentially every pair is inseparable; NO ranking claims. The w chosen for y45 was selected on ~13 val positives (noise-fit) and is NOT a headline result.
